description: This file contains functions and constants for redacting sensitive information in configuration objects and raw JSON strings, including mechanisms for redacting, collecting, and restoring sensitive data, with support for schema hints and secret references.

classes.name: RedactionError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling redaction-related errors, including human-readable messages.

methods.name: isSensitivePath
methods.description: Checks if a given path is considered sensitive based on schema.

methods.name: isEnvVarPlaceholder
methods.description: Determines if a string value is an environment variable placeholder.

methods.name: isWholeObjectSensitivePath
methods.description: Checks if a path refers to whole sensitive objects like service accounts.

methods.name: isSensitiveUrlPath
methods.description: Checks if a path is related to sensitive URL configuration.

methods.name: hasSensitiveUrlHintPath
methods.description: Checks if any of the given paths have sensitive URL hints based on schema hints.

methods.name: collectSensitiveStrings
methods.description: Recursively collects all sensitive string values from a config object.

methods.name: buildRedactionLookup
methods.description: Builds a set of paths that should be redacted based on schema hints.

methods.name: redactObject
methods.description: Deeply redacts sensitive values in an object based on hints.

methods.name: collectSensitiveValues
methods.description: Collects all sensitive string values from an object for raw text redaction.

methods.name: redactRawText
methods.description: Replaces sensitive values in raw JSON5 string with sentinel.

methods.name: redactConfigObject
methods.description: Redacts sensitive fields from a config object, preserving config identity.

methods.name: redactConfigSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a redacted copy of a config snapshot, including raw, parsed, and resolved data.

methods.name: restoreRedactedValues
methods.description: Restores original values in a config object where redacted sentinel is present.

methods.name: assertNoRedactedSentinel
methods.description: Ensures no redacted sentinel remains in the data, throws error if found.

methods.name: maybeRestoreSecretRefId
methods.description: Restores secret reference IDs if they are redacted placeholders.
